patterns.message: Core (src/infrastructure) modules may not deep-import agency modules (ADR-0007 dependency rule); resolve providers through agencies/index.ts.

The agency seam may not deep-import an agency module (ADR-0007); providers are built from a module's manifest and schematic. The companion guard in tests/unit/agency-module-shape.test.ts asserts that module directories hold no TypeScript at all, so either half failing should fail loudly.
